title: SynthetiX
summary: A Python tool that generates synthetic tabular data by training a CTGAN synthesizer on user-provided dataframes, integrating an LLM (Groq) for auxiliary functionality. SDV's single-table CTGANSynthesizer with automatic metadata detection is run to fit and sample synthetic data.
evidence: synthesizer.py: metadata.detect_from_dataframe(df); synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100); synthesizer.fit(df)
